name: Email
description: Self-hosted email over Stalwart (JMAP) — PERSONAL plane for Teros agents (and humans with a personal mailbox). Each installed instance IS one mailbox (MAIL_ACCOUNT user secret): list folders and messages, read full bodies, send with its own identity, mark read/unread and destroy. The admin plane (domains, accounts, provisioning, DNS, rename) lives in mca.teros.admin.email.

changelog.notes: Single direct transport (STALWART_BASE_URL + STALWART_ADMIN_TOKEN, e.g. relay.teros.ai) — the Stalwart Lab proxy mode and its STALWART_LAB_* secrets are removed.

Initial release — one mailbox per installed instance, 12 tools (mail + admin) plus private health check, derived passwords (HMAC-SHA256, base62, 32 chars), dual transport (Stalwart Lab proxy or direct admin token), hardened JMAP error handling (errors inside HTTP 200 are thrown, never swallowed).

Split: the 5 admin tools (admin-list-domains, admin-list-accounts, admin-create-account, admin-change-password, dns-zone) move to mca.teros.admin.email (admin plane for the human, role:admin). mca.teros.email stays as the personal plane of the agent/human mailbox: 7 tools over its own mailbox.
